name: Vàm Sát
nameVi: Khu du lịch sinh thái Vàm Sát
kicker: Forest centre for the creek boats
summary: Mangrove boat centre: pay the road gate and ride a creek for half a day. The 60,000 VND gate includes the shuttle and leaves the boat extra. Be out by 17:00 if the beach town is your evening.
dotReason: The boat day inside the reserve, not the whole night.
timeNeeded: A half day at the gate
getThere: Along đường Rừng Sác after the Bình Khánh ferry.
heroCaption: A boat on a Vàm Sát creek, with mangrove roots along the bank

notice.title: The road gate leaves the boat extra
notice.body: The 60,000 VND road gate includes the shuttle. The canoe and the wooden boat from cầu Dần Xây are separate prices.

body: Pay at the road gate, ride the shuttle, and pick a boat at cầu Dần Xây. The circuit takes in the wild-monkey reserve, a crocodile swamp, a caged fishing boat, Tràm Chim, Đầm Dơi, a forest walk, and tháp Tang Bồng. The gate is in tiểu khu 15A. From 1 July 2025 that ground sits inside xã An Thới Đông. The reserve holds more than 1,000 long-tailed macaques, and also over 2,000 monkeys.

The road gate is 60,000 VND with the shuttle. Under 6 is free, ages 6–11 pay half, and over 11 is an adult ticket. A canoe from cầu Dần Xây runs from 1,075,000 VND for one person to 270,000 VND a person once nineteen share the boat, or from 270,000 VND to 895,000 VND. The wooden boat to Đầm Dơi is capped at two hours. The bird reserve is 55,000 VND from May through October. The gate is 8:00–17:00 every day.

A family room for two at the centre is 600,000 VND on a weekday night and 750,000 VND on a weekend night, with breakfast included. These are the centre’s own rooms. Be out by 17:00 if Hàng Dương is the evening.

gettingThere: From Ho Chi Minh City, follow Nguyễn Văn Linh and Huỳnh Tấn Phát to phà Bình Khánh. The road is about 50 km, about 1 hour 30 minutes to about 2 hours. On the water the crossing is about 10–15 minutes, about 1.2 km on the Soài Rạp. After the ferry, follow đường Rừng Sác to the road gate or to cầu Dần Xây.
From the beach town, the same forest road leads to cầu Dần Xây or the road gate.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: Nguyễn Văn Linh, then Huỳnh Tấn Phát, to the Bình Khánh ferry, then đường Rừng Sác. About 50 km, about 1 hour 30 minutes to about 2 hours. From 18 March 2026 a walk or bicycle is 3,000 VND and a motorbike is 8,000 VND.

legs.heading: From the beach town
legs.body: Along đường Rừng Sác to cầu Dần Xây or the road gate.

admissionNote: Road gate 60,000 VND, shuttle included. Under 6 free, ages 6–11 half, over 11 an adult ticket. Boats from cầu Dần Xây are extra. A canoe runs from 1,075,000 VND for one person to 270,000 VND a person from nineteen, or from 270,000 VND to 895,000 VND. The wooden boat to Đầm Dơi is capped at two hours. Add-ons include a crocodile swamp shuttle at 20,000 VND, a caged crocodile boat at 60,000 VND, a bird reserve at 55,000 VND from May through October, a rowing boat at Đầm Dơi at 65,000 VND, and a canoe to Đầm Dơi at 185,000 VND.
